label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1, late in the episode (trial >= ~80)
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (99% of mass) after the agent chose a2, and only late in the episode: never before trial ~55, rising steeply from trial 70 (75% of mass in trials 90-99). Strongest when a2 rarely reached S1 (in_state S1 holds 87% of mass), and it builds up over consecutive a2->S1 rare trials (top windows: 0.6 -> 0.9 -> 1.0). Weaker activations also appear at D2 after a2->S2 common very late in the episode. Never fires at GO, almost never at D1, and essentially never after a1. Activity coincides with low value (<5.2) and a strongly a2-favouring policy logit. False positives are mostly late a2->S1 rare trials where the agent had been choosing a1 or S1 was good, and misses are a2 D2 steps at trials 70-80 or a2->S2 trials. The dependence on episode time suggests a slow drift of the hidden state rather than a clean task variable. All variables are observed at D2 (action and state are known by then).
